Final make check passed: 2163 passed, 5 skipped in 202.16s, and the CLI help smoke check completed. An earlier full-check run reported 29 failures (25 in test_comfyui_adapter.py and 4 in test_backend_evidence_v3.py); one release-policy case also failed in a clean archive of base commit 548d289b39882ab20d1ee080e70b490805ad7abc. The final full-check rerun passed without reproducing those failures; the reason for the differing outcomes was not isolated. Five skips require native Linux/APEX conditions.
The missing preview/final pairing regression failed before the validator fix and passed afterward; valid paired cases remain accepted.
Read-only integrity regressions confirm recovery and report inspection do not persist integrity observations and do not recreate a missing GenerationService database.
The matrix status regression confirms summary counts follow benchmark_status while matrix_execution reflects the persisted service execution outcome.

Independent source reviews found integrity persistence during report/recovery, omitted facade constants, and stale documentation about integrity persistence. Those findings were corrected and covered by tests or documentation updates. A final read-only source review found no remaining concrete findings in database opening or benchmark-versus-service status reporting.

Final staged Cubic review completed with no issues found after rejecting malformed candidate component roles. Earlier review observations about empty required-role lists and the exact deterministic CPU test adapter were checked against the supported T07 parser contract and explicit CPU testing path.

technical_acceptance_criteria.evidence: Manifest validation requires three distinct conditioning styles, four distinct prompt/operation scenarios, and two distinct seeds. Tests confirm 24 unique case identities and request digests with one output request per case.

The versioned benchmark ledger atomically freezes run identity, all case requests, canonical digests, operation intent, and stable keys before service submission. Changed execution identity blocks new admission; the GenerationService schema is unchanged.

A deterministic termination test stops after service acceptance and resumes by the persisted key, verifies the original digest and job/request IDs, and confirms no duplicate job is created, even when current execution configuration is unavailable.

Resume reconciles persisted jobs before checking whether new execution is allowed. SQLite claims fence competing runners, stale claim epochs cannot update cases, and a deliberately new run receives fresh service-generated request and job identities.

New submissions and queued continuations reach GenerationService only after fixture preflight, compatible frozen execution identity, and service-path checks; GenerationService retains current privacy, capability, adapter, admission, and attempt-budget gates. The selected T07 component identity is checked by ID, role, SHA-256, precision, and quantization. Auxiliary candidate components are permitted, while the exact deterministic CPU test configuration is the only candidate-free path.

The protocol creates separately counted capability, edit, regeneration, chain, composition, and outfit cases and preserves ordered conditioning inputs and chain steps. No live pinned APEX outputs are available to evaluate those supplementary results or chain identity drift.

Preview and final are separate experimental requests with pairing and creative-origin relations distinct from conditioning inputs. No live APEX pair artifacts are available to inspect composition or identity differences.

Reports preserve all 24 matrix denominator slots and distinguish retrieval, benchmark outcome, reconciled service execution, and artifact integrity. Summary status counts follow benchmark_status, while matrix_execution derives completeness and success from service_execution_status. Read-only artifact checks do not create a missing service database or persist integrity observations. A fully executed deterministic CPU matrix remains separate from unverified APEX execution and qualification.

The final Python 3.14.4 focused screening and CLI suite passed 50 tests, covering exact candidate identity, required-role coverage, malformed candidate roles, read-only recovery and reporting, submission accounting, and deterministic CPU matrix execution. The final full make check passed 2163 tests with 5 native Linux/APEX skips; an earlier run reported failures that did not recur on the final rerun.
